verdict.rationale: Crossplane is API-first. Every capability is exposed as declarative Kubernetes custom resources (Providers, Compositions, XRDs, managed resources). The docs say these APIs are for humans, automation, and AI agents, and that they work with all standard Kubernetes tooling and the official CLI. Because the evidence shows no separate UI, the API is effectively the full interface. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of API/UI parity (no UI is documented to compare against), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
